name: contentful-batch-migrator
description: A robust solution for migrating large Contentful spaces without hitting rate limits

scripts.help:
echo '
📚 Available Commands:
  npm run split                  - Split export into batches
  npm run import                 - Import batches (SDK-based)
  npm run import:cli             - Import batches (CLI-based, recommended for assets)
  npm run test:import:cli [N]    - Test CLI import on single batch (default: batch 1)
  npm run import:direct          - Import full file directly (no batching)
  npm run validate               - Validate migration
  npm run resume                 - Resume failed SDK import
  npm run resume:cli             - Resume failed CLI import
  npm run cascade-publish        - Publish drafts with dependency resolution
  npm run cascade-publish:dry-run- Preview cascade publish (no actual publishing)
  npm run cleanup-drafts         - Remove orphan and invalid drafts
  npm run strip-validations      - Remove validations from export (before split)
  npm run restore-validations    - Restore validations after migration
  npm run clean                  - Remove batches directory
  npm run clean:all              - Remove batches and export
'

author: Faisal Basra <faisal.basra@gmail.com>
